upstream.drop_when: The legacy camera's full-resolution RAW10 path still uses this software Quad CFA converter. Drop when the selected demosaic release derives block corners and red/blue interpolation axes from all four CFA orders and crop phases, and preserves CFA phase at image borders; verify colored flat fields and measured samples across every phase. Alternatively remove the dependency with a verified native full-resolution remosaic path, not enlarged binned images or a new software fallback.
